inputs: One valid frame x=(1/5,9/10), E=D=I, codebook e0=(0,0), e1=(1,1); beta=1/4; learning rate=1/10. Two scalar entries in every MSE denominator.

steps.formula: dLcode/de1=e1-x=(0.8,0.1); dLcode/de0=(0,0); hard reconstruction has same codebook derivative; STE reconstruction has none
Remove only commitment gradient, so dL/dE=g x^T; codebook and decoder losses/gradients unchanged
target=x[valid] precedes encoder, distance, all losses and bincount; changing only invalid rows cannot alter any subsequently used tensor
steps.expected: Same valid target and results for every representable finite padding replacement of the same shape/dtype.

tolerance: These are exact rational hand calculations. The separate executed FP32 artifact is compared to six-place textbook prints; beta=0 raw gradient atol=1e-7, rtol=0.
scope: This derivation is not labeled as an executed experiment or evidence of learned audio quality.
